query: I have a 76‑year‑old female with lower GI bleed. In women 71–81 with LGIB, mean radiography/CTs per admission for 1–3 vs 4–7 day stays, by primary vs secondary diagnosis?
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, d.icd_code, s.stay_length, o.order_type, AVG(o.value) AS avg_value FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id JOIN chartevents c ON a.subject_id = c.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = c.hadm_id JOIN procedureevents pr ON a.subject_id = pr.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = pr.hadm_id JOIN orderevents o ON a.subject_id = o.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = o.hadm_id AND c.charttime BETWEEN o.starttime AND o.endtime JOIN stay s ON a.subject_id = s.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = s.stay_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_year_group = '71-81' AND d.icd_code = 'LGIB' AND s.stay_length BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND o.order_type IN ('radiography', 'CT') GROUP BY p.gender, d.icd_code, s.stay_length, o.order_type ORDER BY p.gender, d.icd_code, s.stay_length, o.order_type NULLS LAST;
